title: Market Watch
description: Net new 52-week highs for the main indices, with the runs of three sessions or more on one side of zero marked as a positive or negative bias. Linked from CAN SLIM and Stock Trend.

links.title: Stock Trend
links.tooltip: A stock's daily candles and its trend

target.queryText:
SELECT MIN(t.executed_ts) AS time,
       i.symbol || ' ' || t.side || ' ' || SUM(t.quantity) || ' @ '
         || printf('%.2f', SUM(t.quantity * t.price) / SUM(t.quantity))
         || CASE WHEN n.sentiment IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' - ' || n.sentiment END
         || CASE WHEN n.note IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ': ' || n.note END AS text,
       t.side || COALESCE(',' || n.sentiment, '') AS tags
FROM trade_note n
JOIN trade t ON t.id = n.trade_id
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
WHERE t.side = 'BUY'
GROUP BY i.symbol, t.session_date, t.side, COALESCE(t.order_id, 'at' || t.executed_ts), n.sentiment, n.note
ORDER BY MIN(t.executed_ts)
LIMIT 500

panels.title: The latest session: net new highs and the run each index is in
panels.description: For each index, on the latest session its members have bars for: the new 52-week highs and lows, their difference and its average over the last 10 sessions, and the run of sessions on the same side of zero it is in. Net new highs above zero 3 sessions in a row or more is a **positive bias**; below zero 3 in a row or more, a **negative bias**. Runs are counted over the last three months. *Members counted* are those with a year of bars behind the day.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH picked AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.index_name, i.id AS instrument_id
  FROM index_member m
  JOIN instrument i ON i.symbol = m.symbol AND i.exchange = m.exchange AND i.segment = 'CASH'
  WHERE m.index_name IN (${index:sqlstring})
),
positions AS (
  SELECT index_name, MIN(index_position) AS position FROM index_member GROUP BY index_name
),
stocks AS (SELECT DISTINCT instrument_id FROM picked),
listed AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, julianday(MIN(b.session_date)) AS first_day
  FROM daily_bar b
  JOIN stocks s ON s.instrument_id = b.instrument_id
  GROUP BY b.instrument_id
),
latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(b.session_date) AS last_day FROM daily_bar b JOIN stocks s ON s.instrument_id = b.instrument_id
),
bars AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, b.session_date, julianday(b.session_date) AS day, b.high, b.low
  FROM daily_bar b
  JOIN stocks s ON s.instrument_id = b.instrument_id
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE b.session_date >= date(latest.last_day, '-460 days')
),
marked AS (
  SELECT y.instrument_id, y.session_date, y.high > y.year_high AS new_high, y.low < y.year_low AS new_low
  FROM (SELECT bars.*, MAX(high) OVER last_year AS year_high, MIN(low) OVER last_year AS year_low
        FROM bars
        WINDOW last_year AS (PARTITION BY instrument_id ORDER BY day RANGE BETWEEN 364 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)) y
  JOIN listed l ON l.instrument_id = y.instrument_id
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE y.day - l.first_day >= 364 AND y.session_date >= date(latest.last_day, '-96 days')
),
days AS (
  SELECT p.index_name, k.session_date, SUM(k.new_high) AS highs, SUM(k.new_low) AS lows, COUNT(*) AS counted
  FROM marked k
  JOIN picked p ON p.instrument_id = k.instrument_id
  GROUP BY p.index_name, k.session_date
),
sides AS (
  SELECT d.*, highs - lows AS net,
         CASE WHEN highs > lows THEN 1 WHEN highs < lows THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS side
  FROM days d
),
runs AS (
  SELECT s.*, SUM(starts) OVER (PARTITION BY index_name ORDER BY session_date) AS run
  FROM (SELECT sides.*,
               CASE WHEN side = LAG(side) OVER (PARTITION BY index_name ORDER BY session_date) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS starts
        FROM sides) s
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT runs.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY index_name, run ORDER BY session_date) AS day_of_run,
         AVG(net) OVER ten AS average, COUNT(*) OVER ten AS averaged
  FROM runs
  WINDOW ten AS (PARTITION BY index_name ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 9 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT s.index_name AS "Index",
       CAST(strftime('%d', s.session_date) AS INTEGER) || ' '
         || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(strftime('%m', s.session_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3)
         || ' ' || strftime('%Y', s.session_date) AS "As of",
       s.net AS "Net new highs",
       CASE WHEN s.averaged = 10 THEN ROUND(s.average, 1) END AS "10-day average",
       s.highs AS "New 52-week highs",
       s.lows AS "New 52-week lows",
       CASE WHEN s.side = 1 AND s.day_of_run >= 3 THEN 'Positive bias'
            WHEN s.side = -1 AND s.day_of_run >= 3 THEN 'Negative bias'
            ELSE 'None' END AS "Bias",
       CASE WHEN s.side = 1 THEN s.day_of_run || ' with more highs'
            WHEN s.side = -1 THEN s.day_of_run || ' with more lows'
            ELSE s.day_of_run || ' even' END AS "Sessions in a row",
       s.counted AS "Members counted"
FROM streaks s
JOIN positions p ON p.index_name = s.index_name
WHERE s.session_date = (SELECT MAX(d.session_date) FROM days d WHERE d.index_name = s.index_name)
ORDER BY p.position, s.index_name

panels.title: $index: net new 52-week highs a session
panels.description:
Each session's **net new highs** for the index: how many of its members made a new 52-week high that day, less how many made a new 52-week low. Green bars are days with more highs, red bars days with more lows; the line is the average of the last 10 sessions.

- A **new 52-week high** is a day's high above every high of the 52 weeks (364 days) before it; a **new low**, a day's low below every low of them. A member counts only once a whole year of its daily bars lies behind the day, so a stock listed within the year is left out rather than making a new high every day.
- **Positive bias** (green background): net new highs above zero for 3 sessions in a row, shaded from the third of them for as long as the run lasts. **Negative bias** (red background): below zero 3 in a row. A bias is marked from the day it is confirmed, so a day never changes colour after the fact; a session with as many highs as lows ends a run.
- Hover a day for the highs, the lows, net new highs as a share of the members counted, and how many were counted.

The definitions follow the *NSE Net New Highs* indicator on TradingView, counted here for each index's members rather than the whole exchange. The members are the index's today, read from NSE's list each evening (the SENSEX from the settings, as BSE publishes no such file), so a stock that has since joined or left changes the past a little. The bars are the daily ones CAN SLIM keeps, read two years back for the members by `CanSlimMain marketwatch`.

matcher.options: ^(Net new highs|New 52-week highs|New 52-week lows|Members with a year of bars|Net new highs, % of members)$

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.id AS instrument_id
  FROM index_member m
  JOIN instrument i ON i.symbol = m.symbol AND i.exchange = m.exchange AND i.segment = 'CASH'
  WHERE m.index_name IN (${index:sqlstring})
),
listed AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, julianday(MIN(b.session_date)) AS first_day
  FROM daily_bar b
  JOIN members s ON s.instrument_id = b.instrument_id
  GROUP BY b.instrument_id
),
bars AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, b.session_date, b.ts_epoch, julianday(b.session_date) AS day, b.high, b.low
  FROM daily_bar b
  JOIN members m ON m.instrument_id = b.instrument_id
  WHERE b.session_date >= date($__from/1000, 'unixepoch', '-400 days')
),
year_before AS (
  SELECT bars.*, MAX(high) OVER last_year AS year_high, MIN(low) OVER last_year AS year_low
  FROM bars
  WINDOW last_year AS (PARTITION BY instrument_id ORDER BY day RANGE BETWEEN 364 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
days AS (
  SELECT y.session_date, MIN(y.ts_epoch) AS ts,
         SUM(y.high > y.year_high) AS highs, SUM(y.low < y.year_low) AS lows, COUNT(*) AS counted
  FROM year_before y
  JOIN listed l ON l.instrument_id = y.instrument_id
  WHERE y.day - l.first_day >= 364
    AND y.session_date >= date($__from/1000, 'unixepoch', '-36 days')
  GROUP BY y.session_date
),
sides AS (
  SELECT d.*, highs - lows AS net,
         CASE WHEN highs > lows THEN 1 WHEN highs < lows THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS side
  FROM days d
),
runs AS (
  SELECT s.*, SUM(starts) OVER (ORDER BY session_date) AS run
  FROM (SELECT sides.*,
               CASE WHEN side = LAG(side) OVER (ORDER BY session_date) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS starts
        FROM sides) s
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT runs.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY run ORDER BY session_date) AS day_of_run,
         AVG(net) OVER ten AS average, COUNT(*) OVER ten AS averaged
  FROM runs
  WINDOW ten AS (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 9 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT ts AS time,
       CASE WHEN net > 0 THEN net END AS "More new highs",
       CASE WHEN net < 0 THEN net END AS "More new lows",
       CASE WHEN averaged = 10 THEN ROUND(average, 1) END AS "10-day average",
       CASE WHEN side = 1 AND day_of_run >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Positive bias",
       CASE WHEN side = -1 AND day_of_run >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Negative bias",
       net AS "Net new highs",
       ROUND(100.0 * net / counted, 1) AS "Net new highs, % of members",
       highs AS "New 52-week highs", lows AS "New 52-week lows",
       counted AS "Members with a year of bars"
FROM streaks
ORDER BY session_date

panels.title: New 52-week highs and lows on the latest session
panels.description: The members of the indices picked that made a new 52-week high or low on the latest session their indices have bars for, highs first: the day's high against the highest high of the 52 weeks before it, or its low against the lowest low. Only members with a year of bars behind the day. Click a symbol for it on CAN SLIM.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH picked AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.index_name, m.index_position, i.id AS instrument_id
  FROM index_member m
  JOIN instrument i ON i.symbol = m.symbol AND i.exchange = m.exchange AND i.segment = 'CASH'
  WHERE m.index_name IN (${index:sqlstring})
),
stocks AS (
  SELECT instrument_id, group_concat(index_name, ', ') AS indices
  FROM (SELECT * FROM picked ORDER BY index_position)
  GROUP BY instrument_id
),
listed AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, julianday(MIN(b.session_date)) AS first_day
  FROM daily_bar b
  JOIN stocks s ON s.instrument_id = b.instrument_id
  GROUP BY b.instrument_id
),
latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(b.session_date) AS last_day FROM daily_bar b JOIN stocks s ON s.instrument_id = b.instrument_id
),
year_before AS (
  SELECT b.instrument_id, MAX(b.high) AS year_high, MIN(b.low) AS year_low
  FROM daily_bar b
  JOIN stocks s ON s.instrument_id = b.instrument_id
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE b.session_date >= date(latest.last_day, '-364 days') AND b.session_date < latest.last_day
  GROUP BY b.instrument_id
),
today AS (
  SELECT b.*, y.year_high, y.year_low, s.indices,
         b.high > y.year_high AS new_high, b.low < y.year_low AS new_low
  FROM daily_bar b
  JOIN stocks s ON s.instrument_id = b.instrument_id
  JOIN year_before y ON y.instrument_id = b.instrument_id
  JOIN listed l ON l.instrument_id = b.instrument_id
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE b.session_date = latest.last_day AND julianday(b.session_date) - l.first_day >= 364
)
SELECT i.symbol AS "Symbol",
       CASE WHEN t.new_high AND t.new_low THEN 'High and low'
            WHEN t.new_high THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS "New 52-week",
       t.close AS "Close",
       CASE WHEN t.new_high THEN t.high END AS "Day's high",
       CASE WHEN t.new_high THEN t.year_high END AS "Previous 52-week high",
       CASE WHEN t.new_low THEN t.low END AS "Day's low",
       CASE WHEN t.new_low THEN t.year_low END AS "Previous 52-week low",
       t.indices AS "In",
       t.session_date AS "Session"
FROM today t
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
WHERE t.new_high OR t.new_low
ORDER BY t.new_high DESC, i.symbol

       CASE WHEN t.new_high AND t.new_low THEN 'High and low'
            WHEN t.new_high THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS "New 52-week",
       t.close AS "Close",
       CASE WHEN t.new_high THEN t.high END AS "Day's high",
       CASE WHEN t.new_high THEN t.year_high END AS "Previous 52-week high",
       CASE WHEN t.new_low THEN t.low END AS "Day's low",
       CASE WHEN t.new_low THEN t.year_low END AS "Previous 52-week low",
       t.indices AS "In",
       t.session_date AS "Session"
FROM today t
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
WHERE t.new_high OR t.new_low
ORDER BY t.new_high DESC, i.symbol
